countChromeDevicesReachingAutoExpiration.description: Generate report of the number of devices expiring in each month of the selected time frame. Devices are grouped by auto update expiration date and model. Further information can be found [here](https://support.google.com/chrome/a/answer/10564947).

customer.description: Required. The customer ID or "my_customer" prefixed with "customers/".

orgUnitId.description: Optional. The organizational unit ID, if omitted, will return data for all organizational units.

minAueDate.description: Optional. Maximum expiration date in format yyyy-mm-dd in UTC timezone. If included returns all devices that have already expired and devices with auto expiration date equal to or later than the minimum date.

maxAueDate.description: Optional. Maximum expiration date in format yyyy-mm-dd in UTC timezone. If included returns all devices that have already expired and devices with auto expiration date equal to or earlier than the maximum date.
